content.text:
This is one axial slice of a T2-weighted fat-suppressed MRI (radiological convention: patient right on image left, anterior at top). It contains a fibrous soft-tissue tumor.

The left panel is the clean image; the right panel shows numbered marks. Choose the ONE mark that lies inside the tumor, as close to its centre as possible. End your reply with a final line exactly: ANSWER: <mark number>

The bright, hyperintense mass sits just posterolateral to the bone, spanning roughly x 400–500 and y 375–500 in the left panel. In the right panel it is offset by about 784 px, so it spans x ≈ 1185–1290 and y ≈ 375–500.

Candidate marks near the mass:
- Mark 644 is at (1238, 442), which is inside the mass near its centre.
- Mark 583 is at (1163, 417), at the left edge, outside the mass.
- Mark 618 is at (1171, 472), at the edge or just outside.
- Mark 617 is at (1305, 472), outside the mass.

Mark 644 is the one closest to the centre of the tumor.

ANSWER: 644
